claims.population: In 2016, Katsina's population was estimated at 429,000.
claims.climate: According to the Köppen climate classification system, Katsina has a hot semi-arid climate, abbreviated BSh; Katsina usually records zero average rainfall from November to March.
claims.economy: The city is the centre of an agricultural region noted for production of groundnuts, cotton, hides, millet and guinea corn and also has mills for producing peanut oil and steel.
claims.heritage: The city of Katsina is home to an 18th-century mosque featuring the Gobarau Minaret. The main gate which leads to the Katsina Royal Palace, Gidan Korau, is known as Kofar Soro.
